name: go-link-video
description: go-link's trailer and demo video, made with Remotion from real recordings of the app (e2e: npm run video)

scripts.trailer: remotion render src/index.ts Trailer ../dist/video/go-link-trailer-en.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 && npm run srt
scripts.demo: remotion render src/index.ts Demo ../dist/video/go-link-demo-en.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 && npm run srt
scripts.trailer:subs: remotion render src/index.ts TrailerEN-subsES ../dist/video/go-link-trailer-en-subs-es.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 && remotion render src/index.ts TrailerEN-subsPT ../dist/video/go-link-trailer-en-subs-pt.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.trailers: npm run trailer && npm run trailer:es && npm run trailer:pt && npm run trailer:subs
scripts.demo:es: remotion render src/index.ts DemoES ../dist/video/go-link-demo-es.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 && npm run srt
scripts.demo:pt: remotion render src/index.ts DemoPT ../dist/video/go-link-demo-pt.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 && npm run srt
scripts.demos: npm run demo && npm run demo:es && npm run demo:pt
